title: Self-Describing Salted Password Hasher
instructions: Implement `PasswordHasher` in `password_hasher.py` using only `hashlib.scrypt`, `secrets`, `hmac` and `base64`. `encode` returns one self-describing string with the algorithm, cost parameters, a fresh salt and the digest. `matches` verifies with the stored parameters, in constant time, and never raises. `needs_rehash` flags outdated or malformed values.

evidence.label: Same password encodes differently each time (random salt) yet both verify
Verifies a correct Unicode password and rejects a wrong one
Verifies with the stored parameters; needs_rehash detects changed cost
Malformed stored values return False from matches and True from needs_rehash
Rejects a stored digest that was tampered with
Rejects an empty password with ValueError
ScryptParams has the specified defaults and is frozen
Default hasher uses n=16384 and round-trips without needing a rehash
A hostile huge cost factor yields False, not an exception or memory blowup
